data.text: I’ll choose 20 too. Kate, John, Jack—match that with 20 each for $20,000 this month. Choosing 10 sacrifices $10,000 immediately without ensuring the others conserve: our decisions are simultaneous, and no one can reserve the grass they leave behind. The trade-off is severe—five choices of 20 leave zero grass, so there’s nothing to regenerate and no future pasture income. I’m choosing the immediate payout, not claiming it’s good long-term management. Kate, will you take 20 rather than hold back?
